note: Read from the gateway's source at this module: whether each public method charges one action of the caller's plan, which methods only the gateway's controllers may call, and which the gateway refuses for every caller.

refused.addICPLiquidity: Refused for every caller: "ICPSwap liquidity is not available through the gateway".
refused.removeICPLiquidity: Refused for every caller: "ICPSwap liquidity is not available through the gateway".
refused.getICPLPPositions: Answers an empty list for every caller: ICPSwap liquidity is not available through the gateway.
refused.lockMyTokens: Refused for every caller: "lockMyTokens is not available: the Solana bridge program and its ICRC ledger do not exist on mainnet. Nothing was locked or charged."
refused.testFaucet: Refused on this gateway: "the faucet exists only on a test gateway". isTestGateway answers false, and setTestGateway refuses on this canister.

notes.executeICPDexSwap: Runs on ICPSwap only. A request for KongSwap is refused: "KongSwap is no longer supported". The swap is paid from, and pays into, the caller's ICRC account inside the gateway (see getMyIcrcWallet).

notes.getICPDexQuote: Quotes ICPSwap only; KongSwap is no longer supported.
notes.getMyIcpSwapOwed: Amounts a failed or incomplete ICPSwap swap still owes the caller.
notes.getMyIcrcWallet: The caller's ICRC account inside the gateway: owner, subaccount and ICP account id. Deposit ICP or ICRC-1 tokens there before sendICP, sendICRC1 or executeICPDexSwap.
